title: Portfolio Configuration Schema v1.1
description: Portfolio workspace registry (projects/_portfolio/portfolio.config.json). Lists active vs pending-onboard projects, per-project SLAs, reminder cadence, and optional editorial overrides per project. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2 / §26.2. Policy key: editorial_override_allowed = true (requires override_rationale).

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1.0 legacy skeleton; v1.1 adds active_projects / editorial_overrides. Strict const per ADR-018 (was loose pattern; H-B v1.4-deep-audit-fix). Future minor bump 1.1 → 1.2 = additive fields, requires migration script.

portfolio_id.description: Lowercase slug for the portfolio workspace.

plugin_version.description: Plugin version this portfolio config was authored against (advisory; not enforced).

active_projects.description: Projects currently in operational rotation — weekly briefs + monthly roundups + portfolio aggregation queries read from these. Minimum 1; soft cap (raised 8→12 when the active portfolio reached 10) — not a hard product limit, raise further as the portfolio grows.

pending_onboard.description: Projects registered in the portfolio but not yet onboarded (no staging data, no operational rotation). Skeleton entries only; do NOT participate in cross_query aggregation.

slas.description: Portfolio-wide SLA defaults. Individual projects can override via editorial_overrides.sla_days with documented rationale.

weekly_sync_max_days.description: Maximum days between staging syncs before a project is considered stale.

monthly_roundup_target_dom.description: Target day-of-month to publish portfolio monthly roundup.

cadence.description: Portfolio reminder schedule — consumed by scheduled-task-registry + SessionStart hook.

cross_query.description: Defaults applied by the portfolio_cross_query tool.

read_only.description: Portfolio is a read-only aggregator. Cannot be disabled.

workspace_path.description: Path to project workspace root, relative to portfolio workspace parent (platinum-premium-seo/), or absolute. Tool expands ~ and relative.

priority.description: Portfolio-level priority. 1 = highest. Drives surfacing order in portfolio-overview + weekly-brief.

last_sync_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last successful staging sync. null → never synced (fresh project).

EditorialOverrides.description: Project-specific deviations from portfolio SLAs/cadence. Every override MUST carry override_rationale documenting why. Pattern from S19 quality_gate 80→75 decision.

sla_days.description: Override weekly_sync_max_days for this project only.

priority.description: Override portfolio priority for this project only (e.g., temporary demotion during maintenance window).

cadence.description: Override reporting cadence for this project only.

override_rationale.description: Free-form documentation of why this override exists. MANDATORY. Reference a decision (D-S##-#) if applicable.

ramp_plan.description: Optional path/plan for retiring this override (e.g., 'revisit after Q2 launch').
